pins.name: 5V
pins.notes: TTL side supply. Isolated from mains by optocouplers

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: UART: the meter receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin (9600 baud, Modbus RTU)

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: UART: the meter sends here. Idles at the 5 V supply: add a divider before the ESP32 RX pin

pins.name: L
pins.notes: MAINS 230 V! Only a qualified person connects this. Never to the ESP32

pins.name: N
pins.notes: MAINS 230 V! Only a qualified person connects this. Never to the ESP32

pins.name: CT+
pins.notes: Current transformer lead (100 A version). The measured wire passes through the CT
